limitations: Static review only. No build driver functions, compiler, tests, native runtime, or Git were run.
The driver expects the final driver-pins.json to bind all relevant inputs before execution; Root owns that final freeze and runtime.

reviewed_build_contract.strict_scope: release all-targets with ui-harness and -D warnings

reviewed_controls: Fresh target directory and exclusive owner/receipt creation refuse reuse before any command.
Source map, six pinned inputs, source review, protocol manifests, driver pins, and matched C diagnostic app are rechecked before and after every command.

The Core test executable is captured from Cargo compiler-artifact JSON, restricted to the private target directory, copied with digest verification, and the retained exact binary is run with eight test threads.
Core integration and Store binaries are matched between Cargo compiler-artifact JSON and Cargo Running lines, then retained with digests.
Test output parsing rejects failed/ignored tests and enforces the required named cases and counts; Core integration requires three binaries totaling 22 tests, Store requires all 12 expected names.
Release app is built in the private target, copied with digest verification, and the three helpers are reused only after matching the qualified release helper manifest.
The terminal receipt is created exclusively only after all nine stages validate; failures after ownership are recorded as terminal failure.
